content_class: model output (per-epoch validation accuracy and loss), not dataset content — no images, no labels, no file names
dtype_note: float64 is required, not a preference: float32 ties distinct val_acc values, which moves acc.index(max(acc)) to an earlier epoch and shifted argmax_in_last_K_frac by 1.5-2 points (measured, 9 Aug)
population: frozen selection audit run dirs UNION RAF-DB finished runs — derived from the two consumers' own definitions, never hand-listed
